honest-test/src/honest_test/generators.p: Non-terminating mutant. fibonacci_sequence seeds `sequence = [0, 1]` and loops `while sequence[-1] <= limit`, appending `sequence[-2] + sequence[-1]`. Shifting the 1 at the sequence seed [0, 1] to 0 collapses the accumulator to 0 (or indexes sequence[0], which is 0), so the last element never exceeds limit and the list grows without bound. The memory-capped harness kills the run at the ceiling; that kill is the detection — the mutant cannot run to completion, so it is declared non-terminating rather than caught by an assertion. Verified by reading the loop: no finite limit terminates it.
